prose: The Information reports that Google DeepMind SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu says Gemini 4 is in the early phase of post-training, and that he hopes to release it 'much earlier' than the end of the year. The signal: Google's next flagship model is past pre-training and on an accelerated timeline. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
highlights: Gemini 4 in early post-training, per DeepMind SVP Kavukcuoglu.
Release hoped for 'much earlier' than end of year.
The Information is paywalled; summary from headline/lead.
